title: Verify the LIVE harness file first (wkappbot-kih is the body) -- reference case
desc: Reference case 2026-06-05: an Opus session burned time/tokens diagnosing harness bugs on a STALE personal-docs guards.ps1 while the live harness had moved to wkappbot-kih (sourced via the symlink hub). Lesson: resolve the hub symlink to find the live file; never assume the CWD repo tools/ harness is live.
steps: REFERENCE CASE (2026-06-05): an Opus session burned significant time and tokens diagnosing harness bugs (A-2: the busy-fleet read-only exemption looked present in source but never worked live; wkhippo recall kept being busy-fleet-blocked) by reading and analysing D:/GitHub/personal-docs/tools/wkharness-guards.ps1 -- which was a STALE DEAD COPY. The harness body had been MOVED to wkappbot-kih. The whole mystery (source has the exemption, live ignores it) dissolved instantly the moment we realised the live file was NOT the one being read.

MECHANISM: the live PreToolUse hook is D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1, a SYMLINK HUB. It resolves its own symlink (Get-Item LinkType then Target) into a canonical path, takes the canonical DIRECTORY, and dot-sources canonicalDir/wkharness-guards.ps1 (plus common/status/post). So the LIVE guards equal wherever the hub symlink points = wkappbot-kih/tools, NOT the current-working-directory repo tools/. A repo can hold a tools/wkharness-guards.ps1 that is a dead leftover.

LESSON and HOW TO FIND LIVE: before diagnosing or editing ANY harness code, VERIFY which file is live. (a) Resolve the hub symlink: Get-Item D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 and read its Target. (b) Hooks: grep ~/.claude/settings.json for the hook -File paths (e.g. nightly-schedule-guard.ps1 lived at wkappbot-sdk/.claude/). (c) Default truth: the harness body is wkappbot-kih. Do NOT assume the CWD repo tools/wkharness-*.ps1 is live -- it may be a stale duplicate. The personal-docs harness copies were git-removed 2026-06-05 to end this confusion (recoverable via revert).

GENERAL PRINCIPLE: a moved or extracted component that leaves DEAD DUPLICATE source across repos is a recurring trap -- you edit or diagnose the copy while the original runs. Always recall and verify the CANONICAL location first (which file does the live process actually load). Pairs with the wkappbot-kih extraction and the cross-repo CLAUDE.md resolution issues. When two repos hold the same source file, find which one the running process loads BEFORE touching either.

MIGRATION TO THE HONGIK KI HARNESS (the Hongik Knowledge-Intelligence Harness = wkappbot-kih, user-named 2026-06-05): the user directed migrating EVERYTHING into wkappbot-kih. PHASED PLAN (verify-then-remove, learned the hard way after a premature removal broke the live harness this session): Phase 1 = make kih/tools a COMPLETE self-contained harness (port or merge every wkharness-*, guard, cp949, and wrappers file from the still-live personal-docs/tools; merge the Agent.ps1 --model auto build from personal-docs commit 3701864 onto kih path-relativized Agent.ps1 commit ae5f365; remove all personal-docs path refs; wkharness-status.ps1 -Test must be GREEN) -- ADDITIVE, does not touch the live hub symlink. Phase 2 = repoint hub symlink D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1 to kih. Phase 3 = verify kih live and green from a fresh session. Phase 4 = git rm the personal-docs harness ONLY after verification. STATUS 2026-06-05: Phase 1 dispatched to Codex but the first attempt hit the wkcodex skill-update lock (recent Edit/git not recorded) -- recording this clears the lock. Retrying Phase 1.

AGENT-SPAWN REFERENCE (verify-then-remove gotcha, hit TWICE 2026-06-05). Before deleting a loose hub harness file like D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1, checking ONLY the settings.json PreToolUse hook is NOT enough. Agent.cmd and Agent.ps1 invoke that SAME literal path for the CHILD agent harness self-check at spawn time. So deleting it makes EVERY delegation fail with: 'The argument D:\GitHub\wkharness.ps1 to the -File parameter does not exist' and '[Agent.ps1] blocked by harness (rc=-196608)'. The file was LOAD-BEARING, not an orphan. RULE: never DELETE a hub harness path other code invokes by literal; recreate it as a thin REDIRECT SHIM that re-execs the kih entry with stdin and args forwarded: pipe the script input to powershell -File <kih wkharness.ps1> then exit LASTEXITCODE. VERIFY-THEN-REMOVE must enumerate ALL references first (settings.json hook AND the Agent spawn path AND any wkcodex symlink), and a clean post-delete -Test can still PASS while delegation is silently broken (because -Test does not spawn child agents through that path). Prefer redirect over delete.
author: claude
